name: After Dark
description: is a large, upscale beachfront venue in Canggu, Bali, known for its luxury pools, multiple bars, restaurants, and daily entertainment. It is a popular spot for day parties, sunset cocktails, and nightlife, with attractions like multiple swimming pools, numerous bars and kitchens, and live DJs and vocalists.
note: This place is famous for its day-party which typically runs from midday into the evening.
